title: 🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE PRODIGAL SON – GOD IS CALLING YOU HOME! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE PRODIGAL SON – GOD IS CALLING YOU HOME! 🔥
📖 Luke 15:11-32 – "But while he was still a long way off, his father saw him and was filled with compassion for him; he ran to his son, threw his arms around him, and kissed him."

❓ READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, I feel like I’ve strayed too far from God. Does He still love me? Can I ever return?"
🔥 YES! This is exactly why Jesus told the Parable of the Prodigal Son!
🚨 No matter how far you’ve fallen, God is always ready to welcome you back! But the real question is—WILL YOU RETURN TO HIM?
⚠️ WARNING: If you continue to run from God, you will face destruction. But if you turn back, He will restore you!

🔥 1. WHAT IS THE PARABLE OF THE PRODIGAL SON?
📖 Luke 15:11-13 – "There was a man who had two sons. The younger one said to his father, ‘Father, give me my share of the estate.’ So he divided his property between them. Not long after that, the younger son got together all he had, set off for a distant country and there squandered his wealth in wild living."
🔥 MEANING:

✔️ The father represents God.
✔️ The prodigal son represents sinners who run away from God.
✔️ The older son represents self-righteous people who don’t understand God’s grace.
💡 The Prodigal Son wanted his father’s blessings, but NOT his father’s presence—just like many today who only seek God when they need something!
🚨 Are you seeking God for who He is, or just for His blessings?

🔥 2. THE PROBLEM – A LIFE AWAY FROM GOD LEADS TO DESTRUCTION!
📖 Luke 15:14-16 – "After he had spent everything, there was a severe famine in that whole country, and he began to be in need. So he went and hired himself out to a citizen of that country, who sent him to his fields to feed pigs. He longed to fill his stomach with the pods that the pigs were eating, but no one gave him anything."
🔥 WHAT HAPPENED TO THE PRODIGAL SON?

❌ He wasted everything. (Luke 15:13)
❌ He ended up in poverty and suffering. (Luke 15:14)
❌ He hit rock bottom—working with pigs, the lowest job for a Jew. (Luke 15:15-16)
💡 SIN ALWAYS PROMISES FREEDOM, BUT IT ONLY BRINGS SLAVERY!
🚨 Are you running from God, thinking you can handle life on your own? Look where it led the prodigal son!

🔥 3. THE TURNING POINT – THE SON REALIZED HIS NEED FOR THE FATHER!
📖 Luke 15:17-19 – "When he came to his senses, he said, ‘How many of my father’s hired servants have food to spare, and here I am starving to death! I will set out and go back to my father and say to him: Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you. I am no longer worthy to be called your son; make me like one of your hired servants.’"
🔥 TRUE REPENTANCE BEGINS WITH RECOGNIZING YOUR SPIRITUAL POVERTY!

✔️ He realized his mistake. (Luke 15:17)
✔️ He humbled himself. (Luke 15:18-19)
✔️ He made the decision to return home. (Luke 15:20)
🚨 THE FIRST STEP TO RESTORATION IS REPENTANCE!
💡 Are you ready to come back to the Father, or will you keep running?

🔥 4. THE FATHER'S LOVE – GOD IS WAITING FOR YOU!
📖 Luke 15:20 – "But while he was still a long way off, his father saw him and was filled with compassion for him; he ran to his son, threw his arms around him and kissed him."
🔥 THIS IS GOD’S HEART FOR EVERY SINNER WHO REPENTS!

✔️ He saw him from far away – God is always watching and waiting for your return!
✔️ He RAN to him – In Jewish culture, fathers never ran to rebellious sons, but God’s love breaks all traditions!
✔️ He embraced him and kissed him – God doesn’t just accept you back—He restores you completely!
🚨 YOU DON’T HAVE TO CLEAN YOURSELF UP FIRST—JUST COME HOME!
💡 ARE YOU READY TO RUN BACK TO GOD?

🔥 5. THE OLDER BROTHER – DON’T BE SELF-RIGHTEOUS!
📖 Luke 15:28-30 – "The older brother became angry and refused to go in. He said, ‘Look! All these years I’ve been slaving for you and never disobeyed your orders. Yet you never gave me even a young goat so I could celebrate with my friends.’"
🔥 THE OLDER BROTHER REPRESENTS:

❌ Self-righteous religious people who think they are better than others.
❌ Those who serve God but don’t understand His grace.
❌ People who are bitter when God forgives someone they think is undeserving.
💡 DON’T BE LIKE THE OLDER BROTHER—REJOICE WHEN A SINNER COMES HOME!
🚨 Are you full of grace, or full of pride?

🔥 FINAL WARNING: WILL YOU RETURN TO THE FATHER?
📖 Isaiah 55:7 – "Let the wicked forsake their ways and the unrighteous their thoughts. Let them turn to the Lord, and He will have mercy on them, and to our God, for He will freely pardon."

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
❌ Stay lost, broken, and spiritually starving in the world?
✔️ Run back to the Father and receive His love, grace, and restoration?
🚨 GOD IS WAITING FOR YOU—BUT YOU MUST CHOOSE TO COME HOME!
💡 Will you make the decision to return to Him today?

🙏 PRAYER TO RETURN TO GOD!
"Father, I have sinned against You. I have run away and tried to live life on my own, but I am broken and empty without You. Forgive me, Lord. I choose to return to You today. Restore me, change me, and help me live for You alone. Thank You for Your grace and love. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
